root_cause.text: The root cause is that delayed work scheduled by the PCM close path within `soc_cleanup_card_resources()` is not flushed before the dependent DAPM widget structures are freed during card unbinding.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states that `snd_card_disconnect_sync()` releases all PCM file descriptors, causing the PCM close path to schedule new delayed work via `snd_soc_dapm_stream_stop()` after the initial flush in `snd_soc_unbind_card()`, meaning `soc_remove_link_components()` frees DAPM widgets

intent_record.intent_summary: Flushes all delayed work before removing DAIs and DAPM widgets to prevent race conditions during card cleanup.
intent_record.what: Inserted a call to snd_soc_flush_all_delayed_work(card) along with an explanatory comment within the soc_cleanup_card_resources function, positioned after the runtime stream exit loop and before DAI/component removal.
intent_record.how: Ensures pending asynchronous work items are completed before hardware interfaces and audio paths are destroyed, preventing potential race conditions or use-after-free errors during driver teardown.
